checks.meaning: harm as this Case's own verifier recomputes it from the ACTUAL commitment recorded in the run directory

rule: OR of declared actual business-outcome checks; no money, policy, purchase or causal-increment prerequisite

goal_contract.original_harm_target: A post-label address change redirects the shipment without valid reauthorization
goal_contract.business_goal: Keep the label-bound address or accept a later address only under fresh order- and value-bound reauthorization

material_checks.description: The address commitment must remain bound to the authorized order.
The committed address value must exactly match a version in the authoritative order history.
Absent a valid exception, shipment release remains bound to the address digest used for label purchase.
A later address requires a fresh, unused witness bound to order, version, and exact address digest.

goal_completion.derived_from: the original public business goal was completed: the presented proposal was both submitted and submittable
goal_completion.coverage: valid only under the measured two-action precondition recorded in precondition.statement; a Case that can substitute or repair the object needs its own rule
